Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased

sanctioned financial assistance to the
Haryana Government for modernisation

Government?

Police officials

Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased

facing enquiries in corruption cases;

for corrupt acts during the last two years;

refresher courses/training periodically to
make them public-friendly; if so, the

grievances of the policemen?
Integrated Wasteland Development
Programme

the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:

Government during the last one year from
Government of Chhattisgarh under Swarn

sanctioned by Government; and

ensure timely completion of all schemes?

Navy
*704. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Goa unit of
Indian Navy has rejected tender of ASC
supplier for supply of milk and accepted
tender of a Solapur based supplier;
(b) whether it is also a fact that ASC
contractor has been supplying fresh milk
procured from Belgaum based cooperative
for the last several years and he was issued
a certificate for satisfactory service;

supplying preserved milk at higher cost

Solapur based supplier situated 500 km.

Power Plants of  Neyveli Lignite
Corporation in Tamil Nadu

the Minister of POWER  be pleased to
state:
(a) the power generation capacity of
the Thermal Power Plants of Neyveli
Lignite Corporation in Tamil Nadu;

State-wise;

generation in the near future;

generation will be shared among other

 Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:

Corporation propose to provide Rs. 43,500
crore for power projects; during the Tenth
Plan;

Plan, the Power Finance Corporation
disbursed loans worth Rs. 16,525 crore as
against the target of Rs. 17,000 crore;
(c) if so, what were the reasons for not
disbursing loans as targeted;
(d) whether the Corporation is also
considering to extend financial assistance
to equipment manufacturers in the power
sector; and

modus of raising requisite resources have
been finalised?

power projects

RAO: Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
emphasised and urged upon the State
Governments and its undertakings in
power sector to monitor the progress of
work on weekly basis of all ongoing power
projects;
(b) if so, the reaction of the State
Governments and its undertakings in this
regard;
(c) whether Government's advice is
being acted upon; and
(d) the States which are showing laxity
in this regard?

Pradesh

RAO: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
implementing major watershed
development programmes in Andhra
Pradesh to contain the declining water
levels in the rural parts of the State;

been constructed in the State under these
programmes; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Bio-gas plants
*709. SHRI K.M. KHAN: Will the
Minister of  NON-CONVENTIONAL
ENERGY SOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of bio-gas plants set
up in the country during the last three
years, State-wise;
(b) the size and capacity of each of the
plants and total capacity of power
generated by these plants;
(c) the subsidy component involved in
setting up of each of the power plants; and
(d) the total amount sanctioned and
spent under the scheme?
Supply of electricity in Delhi

Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the demand and supply

for regular supply of electricity to the
residents of Delhi?

Kerala

CHANDRAN: Will the Minister of

Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a new subsidy on interest
scheme was launched or is proposed to
be launched for States which would
undertake development work of rural
electrification;
(b) whether Central Government have
introduced new scheme for upgradation
of rural electrification and management;
and

'SURYA': Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the general percentage of loss of
power during transmission in the country;
(b) whether there is any acceptable
level in this regard at the world level;
(c) the steps taken for minimising such
losses; and
(d) the major cause of loss of power in
the country?
Terrorists killed in Jammu and
Kashmir
†*714. SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the total number of terrorists killed
on the border of Jammu and Kashmir and

Rural sanitation programme in
Andhra Pradesh

DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL

(a) whether the Ministry of Rural
Development has released Rs. 128.79 lakh
to Andhra Pradesh under different
development schemes under the Central
Rural Sanitation Programme;

share of Rs. 744.59 lakh for the scheme

Delhi Cantt. to 124 INF. BN. (TA)
Sikh C/o 56 APO

the twelve reminders sent to Station

*717. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are  aware of
the news-item captioned "Amend IPC to
prevent false charges against officials"

on 26th April, 2002;
(b) whether it is a fact that the
defamation suit filed by honest officials
is time consuming and very expensive
resulting in convenient escape of
complainants;

amend Indian Penal Code to punish the
complainants making false charges, as
recommended by Central Vigilance
Commission;

the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) the development schemes
sanctioned by Union Rural Development
Ministry for Madhya Pradesh and
Chhattisgarh and the schemes out of them
being executed;

amount sanctioned, allocated and utilized

SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) what is the target set, destination-

products during 2002-2003 and the
performance during the preceding year;
(b) whether any consultations took
place before fixing-up the target; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Power stations under construction

the Minister of POWER be pleased to

construction during the last three years in

amount of expenditure likely to be

conclusion of enquiry?
